description: Deploy one checksum-verified ERP main release as the rootless erp user

runCommand: runuser -u erp -- env HOME=/home/erp PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1002 DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1002/bus /usr/local/bin/erp-release '{{ ReleaseSha }}' '{{ ArchiveSha256 }}'
